# CRS Central

> Hotel Revenue Management Consultancy — Laos, India, Nepal, Malaysia and Vietnam. Hotel revenue management for independent hotels across Laos, India, Nepal, Malaysia and Vietnam. Dynamic pricing, OTA management and a free revenue audit.

CRS Central (A Unit of CRS Chauhan Private Limited, registered in Hyderabad, India) brings the revenue intelligence of five-star hotel chains directly to independent properties at a fraction of the cost, without the hassle of hiring a full in-house team. Our partner hotels have seen revenue growth ranging from 10% to 40%.

## Core Services

- [Revenue Management & Dynamic Pricing](https://crscentral.com/services.html#service-1): Data-driven rate strategies that adjust in real time to market demand, competitor moves and booking pace — maximizing ADR and RevPAR. Fixed monthly fee quoted per hotel based on property size, with no commission on bookings or revenue.
- [OTA & Channel Management](https://crscentral.com/services.html#service-2): Optimization on Booking.com, Agoda, Expedia, Trip.com, MakeMyTrip, and all major platforms — increasing visibility and booking conversion.
- [StayCRS — Cloud PMS, Channel Manager & Booking Engine](https://crscentral.com/staycrs.html): Cloud PMS and real-time channel manager for independent hotels at USD 110 per month with no setup fee, plus a direct Booking Engine at a flat 8% on completed direct bookings.
- [Hotel Website Development](https://crscentral.com/services.html#service-4): Direct-booking hotel websites starting at a one-time charge of USD 380 — fast, mobile-optimized, and SEO-ready.
- [Hotel Digital Marketing](https://crscentral.com/services.html#service-5): Social media management, content creation, and paid Meta Ads starting at USD 299 per month (covering 15 posts, 2 videos, and weekly Meta Ads setup across Instagram, Facebook & YouTube).
- [Reservations Management](https://crscentral.com/services.html#service-6): Accurate, real-time booking management fully integrated with your PMS.
- [Centralized Call Handling](https://crscentral.com/services.html#service-7): Professional, brand-aligned phone support converting inquiries into confirmed bookings. Daily 8:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. ICT (UTC+7), with WhatsApp support until 11:00 p.m. ICT.
- [Guest Support Services](https://crscentral.com/services.html#service-8): Pre-arrival, in-stay, and post-stay communications that build loyalty and online reputation.
- [Upselling & Cross-Selling](https://crscentral.com/services.html#service-9): Strategic room upgrade prompts, package recommendations, and add-on offers that increase Average Daily Rate.
